messages:
Vikram Rao: dropped a tiny prototype: an inline mini-walkthrough that appears above the project list and highlights 3 quickstarts. goal: low friction + in-context help. mock: https://file.mock/redwood/mini-walk.mp4

Ana Lopez: Nice! I like that it doesn't fully block the page. Copy suggestion for primary CTA: 'Create project' vs 'Try quickstart' — prefer shorter. Maybe add subtle help text: 'Runnable demo in 2 minutes'.

Carmen Silva: Accessibility notes: ensure the tour is reachable by keyboard and each step has aria-describedby for the hint text. Also ensure focus returns to the invoking element on dismiss. Example attribute: aria-hidden on background regions while active.

Marco (designbot): Design nits: step indicator needs stronger contrast and smaller hit target for mobile. Primary button contrast is fine, secondary needs boost to 4.5:1. Add 2px outline for focus. I'll attach token update.

Vikram Rao: What about analytics? track 'mini_walkthrough_shown', 'mini_walkthrough_step', 'mini_walkthrough_complete', 'mini_walkthrough_dismiss' with property 'entry_point' (banner|inline).

Ana Lopez: Also A/B copy test: Variant A 'Create project' Variant B 'Try a quickstart'. Run until 750 uniques or 7 days. Metric: CTA click rate + project creation.

Carmen Silva: Acceptance criteria for merge: keyboard navigation works, screen reader reads hint, contrast passes, telemetry events emitted. Add a tiny unit test for focus trap behaviour (non-blocking).

Marco (designbot): Will push updated mock and mobile responsive spec by EOD.

OnboardBot: Created task ONB-401 "Mini-walkthrough inline: copy, a11y, telemetry"
